story: An illustrated guide to our collapsing Antarctic glaciers
text: If you haven't seen it, the following video is amazing. The glacier that's falling apart is about the size of Manhattan. "CHASING ICE captures largest glacier calving ever filmed" [VIDEO]
At 1m50s a huge piece of ancient blue ice rises, reminiscent of a blue whale breaching from the ocean depths. Beautiful: [VIDEO]

story: What it means when a huge Antarctic glacier is unstable
text: Was hoping there would be visual of an unstable glacier, not just text about sea level rise. If you have never seen a glacier calve before, check out these videos: [VIDEO] [LINK] [LINK]
I humbly submit this magnificent calving: [VIDEO] Mind boggling. A chunk of ice the size of Manhattan rolling over.
